column1: # 🔴 THE FINDING, and it refutes the methodological claim p378 built on this dial.
# p378 retired the NEW rate as a leg-selection instrument and promoted the IN-LANGUAGE
# FRACTION as "the right one".  p379 refutes the promotion.  The two legs at 100 pct
# in-language returned ZERO addresses between them.  The leg at 44 pct returned the only new
# repository of the pass, and it was a GERMAN repository.
# 🟢 MECHANISM: a high in-language fraction means the leg reached that language's COMMENTARY
# estate, not its forge.  Japanese and Russian carry two of the largest in-language developer
# writing populations on the web — Qiita, Zenn, Habr, vc.ru, tproger — and an in-language query
# is therefore ANSWERED BY ARTICLES ABOUT REPOSITORIES rather than by repositories.  German's
# commentary estate is thinner, so the German leg fell through to a repository.
# 🔵 The dial that selects a productive leg is the ADDRESS YIELD.  p377's NEW rate does not
# predict it and p378's in-language fraction predicts it BACKWARDS.
# 🔴 AND AN ERROR IN THIS PASS'S OWN REGISTRATION: D-LIMB-3 was registered as "UNCORRELATED",
# carrying p378's framing forward.  The measured relation is INVERSE, which is a stronger
# claim than the limb was built to express.  A limb that can only say "not equal" cannot
# report "opposite".
